sentences.text: Sie hat mir viel von dir erzählt.
sentences.en: She's told me a lot about you.

sentences.text: Hast du es deiner Mutter erzählt?
Hat er dir von seiner Arbeit erzählt?
sentences.en: Did he tell you about his work?

sentences.text: Das hast du mir nie erzählt.
Johannes hat uns eine Geschichte erzählt.

meanings.morph: present, 3rd person singular / 2nd person plural; imperative plural

sentences.text: Er erzählt immer viel von seiner Familie.
sentences.en: He always talks a lot about his family.
She likes to talk about Japan.
What are you two going on about?
sentences.review: 'ihr' does not imply exactly two people, and 'going on about' adds an annoyed tone the learner may not expect; suggest 'What are you (guys) talking about there?'

sentences.text: Mein Vater erzählt nie etwas von früher.
sentences.en: My father never tells us anything about the old days.

sentences.text: Erzählt mal, wie war es in Rom?
sentences.en: Come on, tell me, how was Rome?

sentences.text: Elke erzählt ihrer Tochter jeden Abend eine Geschichte.
sentences.en: Elke tells her daughter a story every evening.
